notes.special.title: The bonus stages' title, on its menu.
notes.special.menu.planet: A stage: a small round world of squares with spheres to run over.
notes.special.menu.tube: A stage: a half-pipe track to run along and up its walls.
notes.special.menu.arena: A stage: karts with balloons in a walled arena, one to four players.
notes.special.menu.turn: A stage: a fort seen from straight above that turns as the soldier turns.
notes.special.again: After a stage: play it again.
notes.special.planet.left: How many blue spheres are left to run over, {n}.
notes.special.planet.red: The stage is lost: the runner touched a red sphere.
notes.special.planet.perfect: The stage is won: every blue sphere was run over.
notes.special.tube.gate: The next gate, {i} of three, and the rings it needs, {n}.
notes.special.tube.short: The stage is lost: a gate needed {n} rings and the runner had fewer.
notes.special.tube.clear: The stage is won: enough rings at all three gates.
notes.special.arena.you: Which player this screen is, P1 to P4.
notes.special.arena.won: The battle is over: player {n} has the last balloon.
notes.special.arena.draw: The battle is over and nobody has the most balloons.
notes.special.turn.down: The stage is lost: the soldier has no lives left.
notes.special.turn.clear: The stage is won: every nest is destroyed.
notes.action.fire: A control's name: the one button, a jump on some stages and a shot on others.
